===='''TSR Signing, 1992 - report by John Brannick'''====


There have been some questions about Jordan's future projects lately and I thought I would pass along some information I got directly from Robert Jordan at a book signing last year.<br />

1. Do you plan to write any more series about Hawkwing or the Age of Legends?

Answer: No. readers will get all the information about those ages that they need in the WoT books.

2. What will your next project be?

Answer: Not sure yet, but not a fantasy - he doesn't want to be stereotyped by critics or fans. He has done research for a nonfiction history of the South's role in the American Revolutionary War.<br />

John Brannick<br />Wright State University
